notes: CHK-007 is checked on i_clk_wr edges while reset is low, not in the same time step as the reset assertion. A concurrent assertion cannot sample between clock edges. CHK-012 compares each output at a posedge with a copy captured at the preceding negedge. It therefore only catches changes between the negedge and the next posedge. CHK-011(a) uses a helper age counter: k is the first edge in the busy interval with i_rst_n_sw=1, and the check needs at least 3 edges from k to m. I have not compiled or run any of this in Verilator.
